svg.title: Meares 1 — underside template
svg.desc: Millimetres. Solid plate with a matching underside edge and through-cut stencil lettering. Import as a filled shape and extrude, for example to 3 mm. Body extends 20 mm beyond deepest contact point. Allerta Stencil letter cutouts with the font's original counter bridges. Side shoulders are 5 mm wide. W=60; R=70.25; T=26.87; B=4. This SVG is a 2D extrusion profile, not an STL.
